notes: output_level_dbu is NOT written: two paths are blended, and the level of their sum depends on how the two path signals correlate, so no single analog level belongs to the model's 0 dBFS (missing term: blend sum).

The interface level was assumed (+12 dBu at 0 dBFS), not given. On a loader or plugin that does not read input_level_dbu / output_level_dbu set its input calibration level to +12 dBu, and its output calibration to match your interface; if your interface's real level differs from +12 dBu the model is driven by the difference.

loaderOrder: Loader order: gate -> NAM (nocab-standard.nam) -> cab IR + post EQ (nocab.ir.wav) -> bus comp

stages.hardware: Gate FIRST in the chain, keyed on the guitar (DI) before any pedal: open at -50 dB, close at -56 dB (hysteresis 6 dB), attack 0.5 ms, hold 20 ms, release 60 ms, range -90 dB.

Load the cab IR V30 Mesa 4x12 (file impulse.wav; by @OutmodedElectronics; t3k; tone3000 id 21). Easiest: load the exported nocab.ir.wav instead; it already holds this cab (and the post EQ) as one IR, mono 48 kHz 32-bit float, loaded WITHOUT loudness normalisation.
Post EQ after the cab: high-pass 80 Hz, 12 dB/oct (Q 0.707); peak 3000 Hz, +2.5 dB, Q 1.2. Already folded into the exported IR (nocab.ir.wav); add it again only if you do not use that IR.

Bus compressor LAST (after the cab / post EQ): threshold -10 dB re the chain's pre-headroom level = -12 dB re 0 dBFS at the exported output, ratio 4:1, attack 1 ms, release 80 ms, knee 3 dB, make-up +1.5 dB, peak detector (the output gain of -2.0 dB is already inside the model).

settings.thresholdReference: pre-headroom chain level (the 6 dB sum headroom is not counted)
